name: Abjuration
description: Protective magic that creates barriers, banishes intruders, removes harmful effects, and dispels other magic.

name: Conjuration
description: Spells that transport creatures and objects across distances, including teleportation and summoning.

name: Divination
description: Spells that reveal information — uncovering secrets, glimpsing the future, finding lost objects.

name: Enchantment
description: Spells that affect the minds of others — controlling, manipulating, or charming them.

name: Evocation
description: Spells that manipulate magical energy to produce a desired effect — fire, force, healing, lightning.

name: Illusion
description: Spells that deceive the senses or minds of others — phantom sounds, sights, smells, or beliefs.

name: Necromancy
description: Spells that manipulate the energies of life and death — raising the dead, draining vitality.

name: Transmutation
description: Spells that change the properties of a creature, object, or environment.
